reframed_request: «Нужно продать цифровые пианино до Нового года» → Sell more in-stock digital pianos (units over the normal run-rate) between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31. To do that, turn the December gift season into coded WhatsApp chats about specific models. The content should resolve the doubts that stall a 200k–2M ₸ purchase: which model, warranty, delivery and returns.
business_objective: Sell +10 digital pianos (working default; conservative +5 / stretch +20) above the normal run-rate, across all in-stock digital piano models. Weight the push toward high-stock SKUs: Estrada EDP-220BK (9 units on site), Casio PX-S1100BKC7 (5), Casio AP-270 BKC7 (5) and Casio AP-300WEC7 (4). Window: 2026-10-13 to 2026-12-31. The absolute target is fixed from the owner's answer to Q2, or from the week-0/2 count, by 2026-10-26.
marketing_objective: Two audiences: (1) parents in Astana, and across Kazakhstan via delivery, who plan a New Year gift for a child who is learning or starting piano; (2) adults restarting piano at home. They send the store a coded WhatsApp message asking for help choosing an in-stock digital piano, or to see or reserve a specific model. Deadline 2026-12-31; the conversion push runs 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31.

success_metric.name: Digital piano units sold above baseline (coded WhatsApp piano chats reported as the attribution floor)
success_metric.how_measured: Units: the owner's weekly sales record (POS/1C/Kaspi) for the digital-piano category, plus the WhatsApp label «Оплачен» on coded chats. Proxy at zero owner minutes: the agent tracks daily stock_qty on every digital piano product page. A stock drop is not a confirmed sale (restocks, other channels), so this proxy is labelled directional. Coded chats come from the per-video codes in the weekly WhatsApp export.
success_metric.target: Conservative +5 / expected +10 / stretch +20 units over baseline across 2026-10-13 to 2026-12-31. Baseline is UNKNOWN: it comes from the owner's monthly figure (Q2), or else from the prior 4 weeks of sales plus the week-0/2 stock-decrement count. Absolute targets are re-fixed as a multiple of baseline on 2026-10-26. Coded piano chats baseline = 0.

leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median of the last 15 posts on that platform (pooled music-retail median until the account has 10 posts)
shares + saves per 1,000 views (choice and gift content should be saved and sent to a spouse or relative)
coded WhatsApp chats about digital pianos per 1,000 views
constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸; boost question deferred until a post qualifies (default)
OWNER: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week, one batched message. No direct contact yet; all asks and approvals go through Andrey (MetaPrompt) and Pavel, which adds latency (stated)
STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week (20 incl. safety), one mid/low-quality phone; audio usable only with the phone close to the instrument (stated)

FILMING: hands, keys, instruments and voice only; no faces until consent is asked (stated: consent unknown → default). Customers only with consent on camera; children (likely buyers' kids) only with a parent's written OK

PRICES: only site prices ≤7 days old, re-fetched before publishing. Casio PX-770 BKC7 price CONFLICT: 695 913 ₸ (2026-10-08) vs 521 935 ₸ (2026-10-09) on the same URL, so it is not used in copy until a re-fetch is stable or the owner confirms (evidence). Derived fact diff_pno (38 973 ₸) is stale for the same reason

STOCK: site stock flags/qty are usable for ≤48 h. Feature only SKUs shown in stock on the day of publishing. No «осталось N» / «последние» even though site qty is visible, unless the owner confirms the count (evidence: 11 of 25 sampled piano listings are out of stock)

OFFER: no new offers. These published terms may be cited exactly: sale-page old/new prices (e.g. Gewa UP365, Kurzweil M100SR, Gewa UP400, re-fetched); free delivery across KZ over 100 000 ₸ (delivery_free_100k); 14-day return of goods of proper quality with the stated conditions, with two-way delivery cost withheld (returns_14d, returns_conditions, returns_cost); minimum 12-month warranty (warranty); Casio 2-year manufacturer warranty with service only in Almaty (warranty_casio); payment methods (payments). NO installment/рассрочка claim; not in ledger (evidence)

CAPACITY: stock-limited, not labour-limited. Site sample 2026-10-08/09 shows 16 in-stock digital piano SKUs ≈ 42 units, many single-unit. December delivery and assembly capacity is unknown, so no «доставим до Нового года» / «завтра» claims (default)
REGULATED: not a regulated category. When content involves children, no outcome claims («ребёнок станет музыкантом») (default)

AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers, naming competitors (default). Also do NOT repeat the site claim «100% оригинальный товар» (absolute, no third-party source), do NOT use «Финальная распродажа» as urgency until reason and end date are confirmed, and do NOT promote the 'delivery compensation for an honest review/video' clause (incentivised reviews; platform-rule risk) (evidence)

ACCOUNTS: YouTube exists (3 620 subs, 379 videos, median 2 300 views, last upload 2026-05-10); Instagram muzzone_astana exists (not analysed: blocks anonymous fetch); VK and Facebook exist; TikTok unknown, so this is an owner ask. Business accounts use commercial-library music only (evidence)
LANGUAGE: RU audience copy; KZ captions only after a native check (default)
APPROVAL: owner approves each weekly batch explicitly via Andrey/Pavel; offers, faces and spend always need explicit approval (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min during working hours (site lists calls Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–17:00) (default)
GUARDRAIL: never feature an out-of-stock piano. The CTA routes only to models in stock on the day of publishing (default)
GUARDRAIL: returns of campaign-sold pianos not above the owner's normal rate. Returns cost the buyer two-way delivery, so the expectations shown in content must be accurate (default)
assumptions: [ASSUMPTION] «до Нового года» = by 2026-12-31; measurement window 2026-10-13 → 2026-12-31 (~11.5 weeks; week 0 = 2026-10-09..12) | if wrong: re-plan backwards from the real date | verify: Q1 answer by 2026-10-10 12:00

SECONDARY: the site-wide «Финальная распродажа» (cymbals, drum kits, amps) may mean store closure, a brand exit or a stock clearance. It gets ≤20% of slots, or waits for the next sprint. If the owner says the store or this line is closing, the primary objective becomes liquidating all stock and the plan is rebuilt

LADDER: «продать пианино» → чтобы что? → cash and inventory turned before year-end → units of digital pianos sold by 2026-12-31 (the first number the business counts). Forks recorded and not chosen: (a) only the high-ticket single units (Gewa UP400 1 380 908 ₸, Dexibell VIVO H10 2 075 617 ₸), which are large value but have tiny volume and slow learning; (b) piano revenue in ₸ rather than units, which needs margin data we do not have. Chosen branch: units across all in-stock models, weighted to high-stock SKUs (Estrada EDP-220BK 9, Casio PX-S1100BKC7 5, AP-270 5, AP-300WE 4), because that is where free 'capacity' (stock) is and it is measurable

BOTTLENECK: consideration, low-to-medium confidence. Evidence: a high-ticket considered purchase (in-stock range 200 720 ₸ – 2 075 617 ₸); choice confusion across ~25 listed models and 6+ brands; real doubts in the ledger (Casio service only in Almaty, warranty_casio; return withholds two-way delivery, returns_cost); brand-only demos underperform on this channel (L006: 390 vs 2 300 median). Conversion is a possible co-bottleneck (WhatsApp reply time and close rate unknown; no chat export yet). Verify with the WhatsApp export in step 2

[ASSUMPTION] Digital piano demand peaks in December as a New Year gift, mostly bought by parents for a child | if wrong: shift hero content to adult self-purchase or the school-year framing | verify: owner's last-year Oct–Dec sales (step 2 money map) + coded chat contents by week 3

[ASSUMPTION] Close rate for coded piano chats is 10–25% (high-ticket, considered) | if wrong: req_views rescales linearly | verify: WhatsApp export count of chats ending in payment/address/pickup, by 2026-10-20

[ASSUMPTION] Short-form platform median ≈ 2 300 views. This is the YouTube channel median and is mostly long-form; the Shorts/Reels/TikTok medians are unknown and probably lower. TikTok would be a cold start | if wrong: ach_views scales down proportionally | verify: own Shorts subset of youtube_channel.json + Instagram insights screenshot, by 2026-10-16

REALISM: per extra piano, req_chats = 1 / close_rate = 4–10. req_views per piano = 4 / (3/1000) to 10 / (0.3/1000) = 1.3k–33k [ASSUMPTION 0.3–3 chats/1k; replace after week 2]. ach_views = ~50 posts (10 posting weeks × 5) × 2 300 × 1.8 ≈ 207k. Ratios: +5 → 7k–167k, ratio 0.03–0.8, feasible. +10 → 13k–333k, ratio 0.06–1.6, feasible to stretch. +20 → 27k–667k, ratio 0.13–3.2, stretch to unrealistic organically. Capacity: ~42 units in stock across 16 SKUs, so not binding at ≤+20, but single-unit SKUs can sell out mid-campaign. Time: 12 weeks > 14 days, so organic can learn, but a considered high-ticket purchase lags views by weeks. Levers if behind on 2026-11-23: warm-base WhatsApp Status/broadcast to opted-in past buyers, approved click-to-WhatsApp boost of proven posts, Kaspi listing check

[ASSUMPTION] Calendar: reach + consideration 2026-10-13 → 2026-11-30, conversion focus 2026-12-01 → 2026-12-31 (F6: conversion in the last 10 days, extended because delivery across KZ needs lead time) | if wrong: compress | verify: owner's delivery lead time to regions (step 2)

JUDGMENT (not covered by METHOD): the site's return clause offers delivery compensation in exchange for an honest review or video. We treat this as an incentivised-review risk and will not promote it; flagged to the owner
clarifying_questions: Почему продать пианино нужно именно до Нового года и что означает «Финальная распродажа» на сайте? 1 — просто сезон подарков, 2 — магазин закрывается или уходит из направления, 3 — освобождаем склад под новую поставку. По умолчанию: 1, и в роликах никаких сроков и слов «последние». Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Сколько цифровых пианино вы обычно продаёте в месяц (примерно) и сколько хотите продать с 13.10 по 31.12? По умолчанию: обычный темп считаем по остаткам на сайте за 2 недели, цель — +10 штук сверх него. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Какие пианино продвигать в первую очередь? 1 — тех, которых больше всего на складе по сайту (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100, Casio AP-270, Casio AP-300 белое), 2 — с лучшей маржой (назовите 2–3 модели), 3 — все в наличии поровну. По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
push_back: Пианино за 200 тыс. – 2 млн ₸ покупают обдуманно, поэтому ролики сначала снимают сомнения (какое выбрать, гарантия, доставка, возврат), и заметных продаж от них раньше чем через 3–4 недели ждать не стоит. Органикой реально +5–10 пианино сверх обычного; больше — только с рассылкой по прошлым покупателям и продвижением лучших роликов, это решим к концу ноября по фактическим цифрам. Слово «Финальная» и сроки в роликах не используем, пока вы не подтвердите причину и дату, а цену Casio PX-770 не показываем: на сайте она за сутки сменилась с 695 913 ₸ на 521 935 ₸. И ещё: компенсация доставки за отзыв (условие на странице возврата) может нарушать правила площадок — советуем её убрать.
